Mapping ticket index to gambler address.

Mapping address to round number last bought in, blocks repeat buys.
Number of tickets issued in the current round; also modulo for winner draw.
Current lottery round counter.
Cached token balance held by the lottery contract.
Referrer address passed to POWM.buy; set to winner on close.
Maximum tickets allowed per buyer per round (default 25).
Constructor: sets current_round=1, owner and masternode_referrer to msg.sender.
Payable donation function that buys PoWM tokens for the lottery via external call.
Payable entry point that buys tokens externally then records gambler tickets up to MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner and masternode_referrer from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner state var.
owner state variable is the trusted value checked by the modifier.
setMaxTokenBuyin is gated by onlyOwner.
openLottery is gated by onlyOwner.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner is gated by onlyOwner.
msg.sender is used as gambler address and mapping key in buyTickets.
Block-derived entropy determines the winner in closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
Winner selection performs a blockhash based pseudo-random draw.
winning_number is produced by the weak randomness expression.
num_tickets_current_round is the modulus of the random draw.
winner = gamblers[winning_number].
gamblers mapping is read to resolve the winner address.
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends ETH to an attacker-controlled address.
winner is the recipient of the full token balance transfer.
External ETH transfer to an arbitrary winner after state changes.
External call to POWM.transfer with unchecked return value.
exact_tokens = maths.myTokens() before transfer.
exact_tokens is the amount passed to maths.transfer.
isLotteryOpen is set to false when closing.
masternode_referrer is overwritten with the winner address.
numTokensInLottery is reset to zero.
External payable POWM.buy call occurs before ticket state updates in buyTickets.
donateToLottery performs the same external POWM.buy call with user ETH.
tokens_after is read via maths.myTokens() after the external buy.
The maths POWM instance is the target of the external buy call.
The maths POWM instance is the target of the token transfer call.
maths = POWM(POWM_address) links the interface to the hardcoded address.
tokens_before comes from maths.myTokens() before the buy.
tokens_bought = (tokens_after - tokens_before) / 1e18.
tokens_after feeds the tokens_bought computation.
The while loop is bounded by tokens_bought which caps loop iterations.
Loop counter increments num_tickets_current_round for each ticket.
Loop writes gamblers[ticket_index] = msg.sender.
token_buyins[msg.sender] = tokens_bought.
last_round_bought[msg.sender] = current_round.
msg.sender is the mapping key for last_round_bought.
require(tokens_bought >= 1 && tokens_bought <= MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN).
setMaxTokenBuyin writes MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
Parameter tokens is the value assigned to MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
openLottery increments current_round.
openLottery resets num_tickets_current_round.
openLottery sets isLotteryOpen = true.
donateToLottery refreshes numTokensInLottery from maths.myTokens().
buyTickets refreshes numTokensInLottery from maths.myTokens().
require(isLotteryOpen == true) guards buyTickets.
require(isLotteryOpen == true) guards closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
require(isLotteryOpen == false) guards setMaxTokenBuyin.
Fallback forwards plain ETH sends to buyTickets.
Fallback branches on msg.sender != POWM token contract address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets masternode_referrer = msg.sender.
Constructor sets current_round = 1.
SafeMath.sub is used to compute the token delta in buyTickets.
SafeMath.div(1e18) converts the token delta to whole tokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter tokens exists only to be written into MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN inside setMaxTokenBuyin.
tokens_before is a transient snapshot of maths.myTokens() inside the buyTickets/donate flow.
tokens_after is a transient snapshot produced by the external maths.buy call in buyTickets.
tokens_bought is a temporary accounting value used for requirements and the ticket loop in buyTickets.
Loop counter i only drives ticket registration inside buyTickets.
winning_number is a temporary index derived from weak randomness in closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
winner is an intermediate address resolved and then paid out inside closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
exact_tokens is a transient balance read used for the token transfer in closeLotteryAndPickWinner.
